cards.back:
A comparison that uses the word like or as.
Bahasa Indonesia: simile, perumpamaan
Example: She ran like the wind is a simile.
cards.say: simile. She ran like the wind is a simile.

cards.back:
A comparison that says one thing is another.
Bahasa Indonesia: metafora
Example: The classroom was a zoo is a metaphor.
cards.say: metaphor. The classroom was a zoo is a metaphor.

cards.back:
Giving human actions to things that are not human.
Bahasa Indonesia: personifikasi
Example: The wind whispered through the trees is personification.
cards.say: personification. The wind whispered through the trees is personification.

cards.back:
Repeating the same sound at the start of nearby words.
Bahasa Indonesia: aliterasi
Example: Peter picked a pot of pickled peppers shows alliteration.
cards.say: alliteration. Peter picked a pot of pickled peppers shows alliteration.

cards.back:
A word that sounds like the noise it describes.
Bahasa Indonesia: onomatope
Example: Buzz, splash and crash are examples of onomatopoeia.
cards.say: onomatopoeia. Buzz, splash and crash are examples of onomatopoeia.

cards.back:
A great exaggeration that is not meant to be believed.
Bahasa Indonesia: hiperbola
Example: I have told you a million times is hyperbole.
cards.say: hyperbole. I have told you a million times is hyperbole.

cards.back:
A phrase whose meaning is different from its separate words.
Bahasa Indonesia: idiom
Example: It is raining cats and dogs is a famous idiom.
cards.say: idiom. It is raining cats and dogs is a famous idiom.

cards.back:
Words that create a picture in the reader's mind.
Bahasa Indonesia: citraan
Example: The poet used imagery to describe the golden sunset.
cards.say: imagery. The poet used imagery to describe the golden sunset.

cards.back:
An object that stands for an idea.
Bahasa Indonesia: simbol
Example: A white dove is a symbol of peace.
cards.say: symbol. A white dove is a symbol of peace.

cards.back:
When the result is the opposite of what you expect.
Bahasa Indonesia: ironi
Example: The fire station caught fire, which was full of irony.
cards.say: irony. The fire station caught fire, which was full of irony.

cards.back:
Two opposite words used together.
Bahasa Indonesia: oksimoron
Example: Deafening silence is an oxymoron because the two words clash.
cards.say: oxymoron. Deafening silence is an oxymoron because the two words clash.

cards.back:
A short, wise saying that many people know.
Bahasa Indonesia: peribahasa
Example: A proverb says that slow and steady wins the race.
cards.say: proverb. A proverb says that slow and steady wins the race.

cards.back:
When words end with the same sound.
Bahasa Indonesia: rima
Example: The words cat and hat make a rhyme because they end alike.
cards.say: rhyme. The words cat and hat make a rhyme because they end alike.

cards.back:
The writer's attitude, shown through word choice.
Bahasa Indonesia: nada, nuansa
Example: The cheerful tone of the letter made me smile.
cards.say: tone. The cheerful tone of the letter made me smile.

cards.back:
The feeling a piece of writing gives the reader.
Bahasa Indonesia: suasana
Example: The dark forest scene created a tense mood.
cards.say: mood. The dark forest scene created a tense mood.

cards.back:
A group of lines in a poem.
Bahasa Indonesia: bait
Example: The first stanza of the poem has four lines.
cards.say: stanza. The first stanza of the poem has four lines.

cards.back:
A line or group of lines in a poem or song.
Bahasa Indonesia: bait puisi
Example: We sang the first verse of the song together.
cards.say: verse. We sang the first verse of the song together.

cards.back:
A line that is repeated in a poem or song.
Bahasa Indonesia: refrain
Example: Everyone joined in the refrain at the end of each verse.
cards.say: refrain. Everyone joined in the refrain at the end of each verse.

cards.back:
A joke that uses a word with two meanings.
Bahasa Indonesia: permainan kata
Example: Tomatoes are good at ketchup is a pun.
cards.say: pun. Tomatoes are good at ketchup is a pun.

cards.back:
Saying the opposite of what you mean to make fun.
Bahasa Indonesia: sarkasme
Example: Oh, great weather is sarcasm when it pours with rain.
cards.say: sarcasm. Oh, great weather is sarcasm when it pours with rain.

cards.back:
The words spoken by characters in a story.
Bahasa Indonesia: dialog
Example: The dialogue in the play made the audience laugh out loud.
cards.say: dialogue. The dialogue in the play made the audience laugh out loud.

cards.back:
Using words to make a picture, not to give the exact meaning.
Bahasa Indonesia: kiasan
Example: A figurative expression makes your writing more colourful and fun.
cards.say: figurative. A figurative expression makes your writing more colourful and fun.

cards.back:
The voice that tells the story.
Bahasa Indonesia: narator
Example: The narrator introduced each character at the start of the book.
cards.say: narrator. The narrator introduced each character at the start of the book.
